summary: Indexed token-history proposals and native greedy/probability-preserving speculation with transactional state and tagged budgets; independent physical batch/workspace integration
implementation_scope: Python indexed copy helpers and a portable C++20 incremental accepted-history index plus C++20 greedy and dense/sparse sampled target/draft verification, branch repair, private RNG and publication controllers; temperature/top-k/top-p/min-p filtering, canonical sparse supports with complete dense fallback and tagged supported-width cost policy. Model arithmetic, device sparse filtering/block verification and learned MTP heads are engine supplied. Runnable synthetic native integration of separate target/draft physical caps and scratch, ordered catch-up, transactional recovery and recorded cap selection.

agent_guidance.use_when: Cheap copy or trained-model drafts can amortize causal target verification while private target/draft state and probability-correct publication remain available
agent_guidance.avoid_when: The engine cannot isolate and settle branches, or complete draft/verification/repair costs exceed ordinary decoding; or routed experts stream from host memory, where verifying several tokens loads the union of their experts

requires.hardware: Python 3.11+ for indexed host helpers; C++20 standard library for native loop, with engine-selected synchronous target hardware
requires.model: Autoregressive greedy or probability target, plus compatible probability draft for sampled mode; isolated materialized prefixes, complete rewind/append and causal D+1 verification; no learned MTP heads supplied
requires.workload: Bounded greedy or sampled speculative rounds with private state, partial publication and explicit probability filtering

contract.input: Accepted prompt/history, bounded proposals, correctly conditioned target predictions, context/output/draft allowances and stop IDs; native target owns fully materialized prefix and next prediction; sampled mode takes compatible target/draft probability states and a private seed
contract.output: Python copy batches/commit plans or native provisional round ID/tokens followed by committed tokens and acceptance/repair counts
contract.ownership: Serialize access. Native controller owns committed target/history and one private pending branch; borrowed round tokens expire on commit/discard. Targets settle all work before return/throw and isolate mutable fork state. Sampled mode owns both committed models, probability rows and RNG; sparse support/dense views borrow their owner. Failed/discarded rounds leave committed RNG unchanged. Noncopyable adaptive policy owns bounded issued timing records; the engine retains and settles physical events.
contract.failure: Reject token/extent/budget errors, malformed probability supports, stale rounds, malformed target histories/predictions and incomplete verification. Complete sparse overflow falls back without losing mass. Failed native commit consumes the branch but leaves a correctly isolated parent unchanged; detected shared parent mutation poisons the controller. Foreign/changed/replayed timing tickets are rejected; valid old-generation observations retire without learning.
contract.core_boundary: Return prepared tokens from Session.advance; call native commit(id, accepted) from Session.commit. Core copies borrowed accepted output and publishes only after successful state repair; account branch and temporary storage explicitly.

dependencies: C++20 standard library; native target arithmetic and physical completion supplied by engine

validation.host: Prompt/history lookup, repeat bounds, append/rewind, stop/vocabulary caps, shared batch costs, greedy mismatch/bonus and commit handoff
validation.native: Greedy transactions and Core/paged-attention synthetic integration, including independent interleaved requests with accepted drafts followed by empty proposals or zero budgets at page boundaries; sampled exhaustive sparse capacity/support and conditional path mass, duplicate permutations, score/filter/tie/min-p combinations, 90000 two-token Markov histories, dense/sparse same-draw transactions, partial/cancelled/failed repair, RNG rollback and issued/stale/foreign/replayed adaptive observations. Generic fixtures do not qualify learned heads or device/model performance.; indexed history: 1000 append/rewind mutations and 8000 proposals against an independent scan oracle at two capacities, aliased input, stop/vocabulary bounds and invalid mutations; physical batching example: independent scratch payloads, caps 1-17, fixed proposals, ordinary-greedy output and recurrent-state/rewind equivalence, padding, partial/zero-budget rounds, failed ingestion/verification/repair, cancellation, retries and recorded-choice replay
validation.performance: No native-engine speed claim; serial fallback, history checks/copies, proposal cost, target verification and repair must be measured together
